description: Sublime 100 m² apartment in the heart of the Marais, a 5-minute walk from Place des Vosges, museums and line 1. In a perfectly quiet location overlooking the courtyard of a listed mansion, this loft for 6 people combines contemporary and chic decor, high-end equipment (75" 8K screen, Miele, Liebherr and Dyson appliances) and generous ceiling heights of 3 metres. Trendy shops, restaurants and bars are just a stone's throw away.The spaceLocated on the first floor (with a lift) of a beautiful Marais building in perfect condition (fully renovated common areas), the apartment overlooks the green courtyard and the gardens of a listed mansion — a haven of calm and character in the heart of Paris.A stone's throw from Place des Vosges, the Hôtel de Ville and the Centre Pompidou, you will have the best of the capital at your fingertips: art, gastronomy, shopping and walks in one of the most beautiful and lively districts of Paris.The apartment includes:- A 35 m² double living room (living room / dining room)- A separate kitchen with a glass roof and a ceiling height of over 4 m, fully equipped with a fridge-freezer, 4-burner induction hob, extractor hood, oven, microwave and dishwasher- A large shower room with double washbasin, illuminated mirror and toilet- A second separate WC with a small washbasin and mirror3 bedrooms:- Bedroom 1: 160×190 double bed, dressing room, TV- Bedroom 2: 140×190 double bed, dressing room- Bedroom 3: 90×190 single bed, dressing room- 1-seater sofa bed available in the living room (4th bed)Comfortable and perfectly equipped for a weekend or a longer stay:- Unlimited very high-speed Wi-Fi- 2 televisions, including a giant 75" 8K screen- Sheets, pillowcases and towels provided and put out- Fully equipped kitchen: crockery, cutlery, pans, kettle, Nespres
